Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ১) If (x + y) : (x - y) = 4 : 1, then (x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup>) : (x<sup>2</sup> - y<sup>2</sup>) is equal to -
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
According to the question,
(x + y)/(x - y) = 4
⇒ x + y = 4x - 4y
⇒ 4x - x = 4y + y
⇒ 3x = 5y
⇒ x/y = 5/3
⇒ x2/y2 = 25/9
Now,
⇒ x2 + y2/x2 - y2
= {(x2 /y2) + 1}/{(x2/y2) - 1}
= {(25/9) +1}/{(25/9 - 1}
(34/9) × (9/16)
= 17/8

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ২) If x/2 = y/3 = z/4 = (2x - 3y + 5z)/k, then the value of k is -
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
Let,
x/2 = y/3 = z/4 = m
Then, x = 2m, y = 3m, z = 4m
∴ x/2 = (2x - 3y + 5z)/k = 2m / 2

(2x - 3y + 5z) / k = 2m / 2
⇒ (2 × 2m - 3 × 3m + 5 × 4m)/k = 2m / 2
⇒ 15m / k = 2m / 2
⇒ k = 15.

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ৩) If the income of A is 10% more than that of B and the income of B is 20% less than that of C, then the incomes of A, B and C respectively are in the ratio -
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
Let,
C's income be x.
Then, B's income = 80% of x = Tk. (4x/5)
A's income = 110% of Tk (4x/5)
= Tk. (110/100) × (4x/5)
= Tk. (22x/25)
∴ A : B : C = 22x/25 : 4x/5 : x
= 22 : 20 : 25.

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ৪) If A : B = 4 : 5, B: C = 7 : 9 and C : D = 3 : 4, and if A’s share is Tk. 1680, the share of D is -

৫) Between two consecutive years my incomes are in the ratio of 2 : 3 and expenses in the ratio 5 : 9. If my income in the second year is Tk. 45000 and my expenses in the first year is Tk. 25000 my total savings for the two years is -
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
Let,
income in the first year be Tk. x and expenses in the second year be Tk. y
Then, x/45000 = 2/3 and 25000/y = 5/9
⇒ x = (2 × 45000)/3
= 30000
and y (25000 × 9)/5
= 45000.
∴ Total savings for 2 years
= Tk. [(30000 - 25000) + (45000 - 45000)]
= Tk. 5000.

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ৬) The cost of a table and a chair are in the ratio of 5 : 7. If the cost of chair and table is increased by 20% and 10% respectively, then what will be the new ratio?
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
Let,
the cost of the table and chair be Tk. 5x and Tk. 7x respectively.
New cost of chair = 120% of Tk. 7x = Tk (6/5 × 7x)
= Tk. 42x/5.
New cost of table = 110% of Tk. 5x = Tk.(11/10 × 5x)
= Tk. 55x/10.
∴ New ratio = 55x/10 : 42x/5
= 55 : 84

এছাড়াও,
5 : 7
নতুন অনুপাতঃ
5 এর 110% : 7 এর 120%
= 5.5 : 8.4

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ৭) How many liters of water should be added to a 30-liter mixture of milk and water containing milk and water in the ratio of 7 : 3 such that the resultant mixture has 40% water in it?
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
The total quantity of mixture = 30 liters
Quantity Milk in the mixture = 7/(7 + 3) × 30 litres = 21 litres
and quality water in the mixture = 3/ (7 + 3) × 30 litre = 9 litre
Let water to be mixed 'a' litre
Then (30 + a) × 40/100 = 9 + a
or, 120 + 4a = 90 + 10a
or, 120 - 90 = 10a - 4a
30 = 6a
⇒ a = 5
Hence, 5 litres water mixed in the mixture.

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ৮) A student took five papers in an examination, where full marks were the same on each paper. Her marks in these papers were in the proportion of 6 : 7 : 8 : 9 : 10. In all these papers together, the candidate obtained 60% of the total marks. Then the number of papers in which she got more than 50% marks is -
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
Let,
the full marks for each paper be x.
Let the marks obtained in the five papers be 6y, 7y, 8y, 9y and 10y respectively.
Then, (6y + 7y + 8y + 9y + 10y)/5x = 60/100
⇒ 40y/5x = 3/5
⇒ 40y = 3x
⇒ x = (40/3)y
50% of x = (50/100) × (40/3)y
= 20y/3
= 6(2/3)y.
Clearly, the student got more than 50% marks in each of the last 4 papers.

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ৯) 15 men, 18 women and 12 boys working together earned Tk. 2070. If the daily wages of a man, a woman and a boy are in the ratio of 4 : 3 : 2, the daily wage (in Tk) of 1 man, 2 women and 3 boys are -
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
Let,
the daily wage of a man, a woman and a boy be Tk. 4x, Tk. 3x and Tk. 2x respectively.
Then, 15 × 4x + 18 × 3x + 12 × 2x = 2070
⇒ 60x + 54x + 24x = 2070
⇒ 138x = 2070
⇒ x = 15
∴ daily wages of 1 man, 2 women and 3 boys
= Tk. (4x + 2 × 3x + 3 × 2x)
= Tk. (4x + 6x + 6x)
= Tk. 16x
= Tk. (16 × 15)
= Tk. 240.

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ১০) Gold is 19 times as heavy as water and copper is 9 times as heavy as water. In what ratio should Gold and Copper be mixed to get an alloy 15 times as heavy as water?
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
G = 19 W and C = 9 W.
Let 1 gm of gold be mixed with x gm of copper to get (1 + x)gm of the alloy.
(1 gm gold) + (x gm copper) = (x + 1) gm of alloy
⇔ 19 W + 9 Wx = (x + 1) × 15 W
⇔ 19 + 9x = 15 (x + 1)
⇔ 6x = 4
⇔ x = 2/3.
Ratio of gold and copper = 1: 2/3
= 3 : 2

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ১১) Find the third proportional to 25 and 30
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
Let third proportional be x
⇒ 25 : 30 : : 30 : x
⇒ 25 × x = 30 x 30
⇒ x = (30 x 30)/25
= 36.

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ১২) If a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> + c<sup>2</sup> - ab - bc - ca = 0 then a : b : c is -
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
a2 + b2 + c2 - ab - bc - ca = 0 .....(i)
Multiple equation (i) by 2 we get
⇒ 2a2 + 2b2 + 2c2 - 2ab - 2bc - 2ca = 0
⇒ (a2 + b2 - 2ab) + (b2 + c2 - 2bc) + (c2 + a2 - 2ca) = 0 [ (a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab]
⇒ (a - b)2 + ((b - c)2 + (c - a)2 = 0 [if x2 + y2 + z2 = 0 then x = 0, y = 0, z = 0]
∴ a - b = 0
⇒ a = b
b - c = 0
⇒ b = c
c - a = 0
⇒ c = a
∴ a : b : c = 1 : 1 : 1

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ১৩) Two alloys contain zinc and copper in the ratio of 2 : 1 and 4 : 1.In what ratio the two alloys should be added together to get a new alloy having zinc and copper in the ratio of 3 : 1?
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
Zinc in first allow = 2/3 units;
Zinc in second alloy = 4/5 units.
copper in first alloy = 1/3 units;
copper in second alloy = 1/5 units.
Let the first and second alloys be mixed in the ratio 1 : y.
Then, {(2/3) + (4y/5)}/{(1/3 + (y/5)) = 3/1
⇒ 10 + 12y = 3 (5 + 3y)
⇒ 10 + 12y = 15 + 9y
⇒ 3y = 5
⇒ y = 5/3.
∴ Required ratio = 1 : 5/3
= 3:5

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ১৪) A, B and C enter into a partnership with the capital in the ratio 7/2 : 4/3 : 6/5. After 4 months A increases his share of capital by 50%. If at the end of the year the total profit earned is Tk. 2430, find the share of each in the profit.
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
Ratio of capitals = 7/2 : 4/3 : 6/5 = (7/2 × 30) : (4/3 × 30) : (6/5 × 30)
= 105 : 40 : 36.
Let the initial capitals of A, B and C be Tk. 105x, 40x, 36x respectively.
Then, ratio of profit = [105x × 4 + (150% of 105x) × 8] : (40x × 12 ) : (36x × 12)
1680 : 480 : 432
= 35 : 10 : 9.
∴ A's share = Tk. (2430 × 35/54) = Tk. 1575; B's share = Tk (2430 × 10/54) = Tk. 450
C's share = Tk. (2430 × 9/54) = Tk. 405.

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ১৫) P, Q and R invested Tk. 45000, Tk. 70000 and Tk. 90000 respectively to start a business. At the end of 2 years, they earned a profit of Tk. 164000. What will be Q’s share in the profit?

১৬) Sima started a software business by investing Tk. 50,000. After six months, Rajon joined her with a capital of Tk. 80000. After 3 years, they earned a profit of Tk. Tk. 24500. What was Sima’s share in the profit?

১৭) A and B started a business in partnership investing Tk. 20000 and Tk. 15000 respectively. After six months, C joined them with Tk. 20000. What will be B’s share in the total profit of Tk. 25000 earned at the end of 2 years from the starting of the business?
১৮) X and Y started a business in the ratio 2 : 3. After 1 year X left the business but Y continues. After 2 years he had the profit of Tk. 26000. What is the profit of Y?
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
Let the initial capital of X and Y be Tk. 2a and Tk. 3a respectively.
Then, Ratio of profits = (2a × 12) : (3a × 24)
= 24a : 72a
= 1 : 3.
∴ Y's share = Tk. (26000 × 3/4)
= Tk. 19500.

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ১৯) Three partners A, B, C start a business. Twice A’s capital is equal to thrice B’s capital and B’s capital is four times C’s capital. Out of a total profit of Tk. 16500 at the end of the year, B’s share is -
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
Let C = x
Then, B = 4x and 2A = 3 × 4x
= 12x
or A = 6x
∴ A : B : C = 6x : 4x : x
= 6 : 4 : 1.
So, B's share = Tk. (16500 × 4/11)
= Tk. 6000

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ২০) Two friends P and Q started a business investing in the ratio of 5 : 6. R joined them after six months investing an amount equal to that of Q’s. At the end of the year, 20% profit was earned which was equal to Tk. 98000. What was the amount invested by R?
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
Let the total investment be Tk. z
Then, 20% of z = 98000
⇒ z = 98000 × 100)/20
= 490000.
Let the capitals of P, Q and R be Tk. 5x, Tk. 6x and Tk. 6x respectively.
Then, (5x × 12) + (6x 12) + (6x × 6) = 490000 × 12
⇔ 168x = 490000 × 12 ⇔ x = (490000 × 12)/168 = 35000.
∴ R's investment = 6x = Tk. (6 × 35000)
= Tk. 210000.

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ২১) A, B and C entered into a partnership by investing Tk 15400, Tk. 18200, Tk. 12600 respectively. B left after 6 months. If after 8 months, there was a profit of Tk. 28790, then what is the share of C in the profit?
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
Investment of A for 8 months = Tk. 15400
Investment of B for 6 months = Tk. 18200
Investment of C for 8 months = Tk. 12600
Ratio of the share of A, B and C = 15400 × 8 : 18200 × 6 : 12600 × 8
= 154 × 8 : 182 × 6 : 126 × 8
= 44 : 39 : 36
Sum of the terms of ratio = 44 + 39 + 36 = 119
Share of C = Tk. (36/119) × 28790 = Tk. 8709.57 ≈ Tk. 8710.

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ২২) Rahul, Amin, and Akash started a business. Rahul invested 1/2 part, Amin 1/3 part and rest of the capital was invested by Akash. The ratio of their profit will be?
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
Let the total capital be Tk. x.
Then, Rahul's share = Tk. x/2
Amin's share = Tk. x/3
Akash's share = [x - {(x/2) + (x/3)}]
= Tk. x/6
∴ Required ratio = x/2 : x/3 : x/6 = 1/2 : 1/3 : 1/6
= 3 : 2 : 1

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ২৩) In a sugar-water solution, the ratio of water to sugar is 8 : 3. If you add 2 kgs of sugar, the ratio becomes 2 : 1. What is the amount of sugar in the original solution in kg?
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
Let
amount of water be 8x.
So, the amount of sugar is 3x.
According to question,
8x/(3x + 2) = 2/1
Solving this equation, we get, x = 2
Therefore, the amount of sugar in the original solution = 3 × 2 = 6 kg.

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ২৪) The ratio of water and salt in a 16 kg of salt - water solution is 3 : 1. How much water in kg must be added to make the ratio of water to salt 4 : 1?
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
salt = 16 × 1/4 = 4 Kg
water = 16 - 4
= 12 kg.
এখন water/salt = 4
∴ water = 4 × 4 = 16 Kg
∴ (16 - 12) = 4 Kg water add করতে হবে।

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ২৫) A 60-litre mixture of sugar and water contains sugar and water in the ratio 2 : 3. How many litres of the mixture should be replaced by sugar so that the ratio of sugar and water becomes 1 : 1?
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
ধরি, mixture এর x পরিমানকে sugar দ্বারা replace করতে হবে ।
অর্থাৎ , sugar/water = {2/5 × (60 - x) + x}/{(3/5) × (60 - x)} = 1/1
Or, (120 - 2x + 5x)/5 = (180 - 3x)/5
Or, 120 + 3x = 180 - 3x
Or, 6x = 60
Or, x = 10.

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ২৬) Ibrahim has 20 ounces of a 20% flavoured solution. How much salt should he add to make it a 25% solution?
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
Let y be the amount of flavour.
(0.2 × 20) + 1 × y = 0.25 (20 + y)
Or, 4 + y = 5 + 0.25y
Or, 0.75y = 1
So, y = 1.33

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ২৭) In what ratio must a grocer mix two varieties of tea worth Tk. 60 a kg and Tk. 65 a kg so that by selling the mixture at Tk. 68.20 a kg he may gain 10%?
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
S.P of 1 kg of the mixture = Tk. 68.20, Gain = 10%
C.P of 1 kg of the mixture = Tk. (100/110 × 68.20) = Tk. 62
By the rule of alligation, we have :

∴ Required ratio = 3 : 2

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ২৮) A dishonest milkman professes to sell his milk at cost price but he mixes it with water and thereby gains 25%. The percentage of water in the mixture is?
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
Let C.P of 1 litre milk be Tk. 1.
Then, S.P of 1 litre of mixture = Tk. 1, Gain = 25%
C.P. of 1 litre mixture = Tk. (100/125) × 1
= Tk. 4/5
By the rule of alligation, we have:

∴ Ratio of the milk to water = 4/5 : 1/5
= 4 : 1.
Hence, percentage of water in the mixture
= {(1/5) × 100}%
= 20%

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ২৯) A container contains 40 litres of milk. From this container, 4 litres of milk was taken out and replaced by water. This process was repeated further two times. How much milk is now contained by the container?
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
Amount of milk left after 3 operations
= [40 {1 - (4/40)}3] litres
= (40 × 9/10 × 9/10 × 9/10) litres
= 29.16 litres.

Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.question: ৩০) 20 litres of a mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 3 : 1. Then the amount of milk to be added to the mixture so as to have milk and water in ratio 4 : 1 is -
Ratio & Proportion, Partnership, Allegat.exp:
In 20 litres of mixture.
Quantity of milk ⇒ 3/4 × 20 = 15 litres
Quantity of Water ⇒ 1/4 × 20 = 5 litres
Let the quantity of milk added be x litres.
According to the question,
(15 + x)/5 = 4/1
⇒ 15 + x = 4 × 5
⇒ x = 20 - 15
= 5 litres.
